episode_title: Taking Stock: How evicting an 87-year-old woman in Spain disrupted the debate on housing

real_qa.q: What housing measures did Spain approve in response to the 87-year-old woman eviction protests in Madrid?
real_qa.r: Spain's government approved new housing measures including a potential ban on evictions until 2030 and a ban on investment firms buying houses. These measures came after an 87-year-old woman was evicted from her home in Madrid, which led to huge protests.

real_qa.q: How much do global households spend on rent according to UN data cited in Business Daily?
real_qa.r: According to the UN, 44% of households globally spend more than 30% of their income on rent, and the world needs around 96,000 additional affordable and accessible homes every single day.

real_qa.q: Why would a US diesel export ban likely increase gasoline prices rather than lower them?
real_qa.r: If the US cannot export diesel, refiners cannot get a good price for their diesel and will cut back production. When crude oil is processed, it produces diesel, gasoline, and jet fuel simultaneously.
